Best with an axe; swords and tools hit at four fifths; empty hands cannot cast. Each form wears the weapon once. Only wooden doors, wooden trapdoors and fence gates break.
technique.meridian_door_breaker.knock.no: three quick knocks; Cleave, Shield Hook or Sweep can follow
technique.meridian_door_breaker.cleave.n: one heavy chop that also breaks doors within 2 blocks ahead; Myriad Doors can follow
technique.meridian_door_breaker.ram.note: charge in and ram once, knocking the target back; Knock can follow
technique.meridian_door_breaker.hook.not: struck on a raised shield, an axe disables it for 5 s, swords and tools for 2 s
technique.meridian_door_breaker.sweep.no: a half circle in front, then behind; up to five targets within 3 blocks
technique.meridian_door_breaker.close.no: two steps back, then one returning chop; Ram can follow
technique.meridian_door_breaker.chain.no: three lunges with a chop each, all at one target; Myriad Doors can follow
technique.meridian_door_breaker.finale.n: only after Cleave or Chained Cuts; a swing, then a leaping chop on up to six targets that breaks doors 3 blocks wide ahead
advancements.meridian_door_breaker.culti: From Knock to Myriad Doors, hewing through layered timber in full stride—no corridor, however deep, can bar the axe.
codex.intro.meridian_door_breaker.door_b: A brutal axe form born in woodland mansions: hewing through door and bolt alike, staying its edge only when met with unyielding iron.
codex.power.meridian_door_breaker.upper: A short, violent rush sends wood and foe flying together. Knocking and cleaving in turn, the axe splinters any hardwood door blocking your way.
codex.power.meridian_door_breaker.middle: Catch heavy shields on the axe's back hook to rip them aside, slip back in a retreating guard, and sweep wide from the waist to tear through a closing ring.
codex.power.meridian_door_breaker.lower: Drive back foes with chained cuts in a rush, leap and feint before bringing the axe straight down—mowing down the line and hewing through rows of timber doors.
